displayAddress: Woofindin Avenue, SHEFFIELD, South Yorkshire, S11
description:
Forming part of this beautiful Edwardian building which occupies an enviable position on the fringe of the glorious Mayfield Valley in substantial, communal grounds that extend to approximately fourteen acres. Properties on this very desirable and sought after development rarely become available on the open market which is testament to how nice it is to live here. The property has an almost rural feel due to its long drive approach and fabulous outlook over the surrounding countryside and yet it is also very conveniently placed for nearby amenities found in both Nether Green, Fulwood Village and Ranmoor.
This lovely first floor apartment forms part of this gorgeous Edwardian conversion that enjoys an unrivalled almost rural location at the foot of the Mayfield Valley as it merges into the very fashionable and desirable suburban areas of Ranmoor and Nether Green. This close proximity of both rural and city life alongside the easy access to the main city hospitals and both universities will make this property appeal to even the most discernible of buyers. The property benefits from stunning south facing views, private car parking within the purpose built covered carparking building and a separate secure private storage unit. The development has a grand feel and is approached via a long driveway that leads through the pretty, communal grounds and beyond to the parking areas. There is a further ample visitors parking areas for guests and visitors. Access to the property is at the rear, via a coded security gate which has an intercom system for additional security. The apartment features two double bedrooms, two bath/shower rooms (one ensuite), and a fabulous, open plan living room (as large as a dance studio). The fitted kitchen has a range of matching units with integrated appliances and a fabulous breakfasting bar and sitting area.
Externally the stunning communal grounds, that extend to approximately fourteen acres of lawns and woodland offer residents plenty of private space to enjoy and access to scenic walks in the lower Mayfield Valley. The grounds, architecture and location combine to make this very much a one off place to live and well worth a visit.
Early viewings are strongly advised to avoid disappointment.
